commonCards.name: Strike
commonCards.description: Deal 5 damage.

commonCards.name: Pummel
commonCards.description: Deal 12 damage.

commonCards.name: Smackdown
commonCards.description: Deal 9 damage.

commonCards.name: Poison Dart
commonCards.description: Apply 3 Poison. Deals 2 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 6 turns, ignoring armor. Slow, but it outlasts almost any fight. Stacks: another Poison adds to the tick and extends the timer, up to 12 turns.

commonCards.name: Torch
commonCards.description: Apply 5 Burn. Deals 7 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 2 turns, ignoring armor. Hits hard and burns out fast. Stacks: another Burn adds to the tick and extends the timer, up to 4 turns.

commonCards.name: Weaken
commonCards.description: Weaken the enemy for 3 turns: their attacks land for 1.5x less damage. Does not stack - reapplying keeps whichever effect is stronger and resets the 3 turns.

commonCards.name: Gale Slash
commonCards.description: Deal 6 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Rend 3: 3 damage the next 3 times it attacks.

commonCards.name: Flame Slash
commonCards.description: Deal 6 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Burn 3: 4 damage a turn for 2 turns.

commonCards.name: Venom Strike
commonCards.description: Deal 6 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Poison 3: 2 damage a turn for 6 turns.

commonCards.name: Flare
commonCards.description: Deal 4 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Burn 3: 4 damage a turn for 2 turns.

commonCards.name: Dagger Throw
commonCards.description: Deal 4 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Rend 3: 3 damage the next 3 times it attacks.

commonCards.name: Sting
commonCards.description: Deal 4 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Poison 3: 2 damage a turn for 6 turns.

commonCards.name: Whirlwind
commonCards.description: Deal 6 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Rend 3: 3 damage the next 3 times it attacks.

commonCards.name: Uppercut
commonCards.description: Deal 10 damage. Ignores the enemy's defense stat entirely, so it lands full against heavily armored foes.

commonCards.name: Shield Bash
commonCards.description: Gain 3 armor, then deal 3 damage that bypasses the enemy's armor.

commonCards.name: Shield Wall
commonCards.description: Gain 9 armor.

commonCards.name: Shield
commonCards.description: Gain 6 armor.

commonCards.name: Combo Strike
commonCards.description: Strike twice for 7 damage each, 14 total. Both hits are reduced by defense separately.

commonCards.name: Taunt
commonCards.description: Provoke the enemy. For their next 2 turns they are far more likely to attack than to defend or cast. Fails one time in five.

commonCards.name: Gust
commonCards.description: Apply 4 Rend. The next 3 times the enemy attacks it takes 4 damage, ignoring armor. A stalling, buffing or stunned enemy takes nothing from it, and anything that swings twice a turn takes it twice. Stacks: another Rend adds to the hit and adds charges, up to 6.

commonCards.name: Fear
commonCards.description: Frighten the enemy. For their next 2 turns they are far more likely to brace than to attack or cast. Useless against anything with no defensive move of its own, and like Taunt it fails one time in five.

commonCards.name: Reckless Swing
commonCards.description: Deal 11 damage. Your cards deal 2 less next turn.

commonCards.name: Heavy Guard
commonCards.description: Gain 12 armor. Your attacks deal 10% less this turn.

commonCards.name: Overextend
commonCards.description: Deal 8 damage, ignoring enemy defense. You draw one fewer card next turn.

commonCards.name: Blood Price
commonCards.description: Gain 2 energy now. You lose 6 HP.

rareCards.name: Strengthen
rareCards.description: Gain x2 damage for 2 turns. Multiplies every attack you play, including riposte and counter damage. Stacks in duration, not power - a second cast adds turns and keeps the stronger multiplier.

rareCards.name: Power Strike
rareCards.description: Deal 19 damage.

rareCards.name: Fortify
rareCards.description: Gain 9 armor. It does not fade at the end of your turn: it lasts 3 turns or until an attack breaks it.

rareCards.name: Cleave
rareCards.description: Deal 18 damage.

rareCards.name: Body Slam
rareCards.description: Deal 18 damage.

rareCards.name: Molten Hammer
rareCards.description: Deal 25 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Burn 3: 4 damage a turn for 2 turns.

rareCards.name: Guardian
rareCards.description: Gain 17 armor.

rareCards.name: Onslaught
rareCards.description: Strike twice for 10 damage each, 20 total. Both hits are reduced by defense separately.

rareCards.name: Retaliate
rareCards.description: Gain 7 armor. 50% chance to Weaken the enemy for 3 turns, making their attacks land for 1.5x less damage.

rareCards.name: Status Guard
rareCards.description: Gain 10 armor and ward yourself for 2 turns. Every ailment the enemy would inflict (Poison, Burn, Weak or Stun) is blocked while it holds.

rareCards.name: Toxic Cloud
rareCards.description: Apply 8 Poison. Deals 4 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 6 turns, ignoring armor. Slow, but it outlasts almost any fight. Stacks: another Poison adds to the tick and extends the timer, up to 12 turns.

rareCards.name: Inferno
rareCards.description: Apply 8 Burn. Deals 12 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 2 turns, ignoring armor. Hits hard and burns out fast. Stacks: another Burn adds to the tick and extends the timer, up to 4 turns.

rareCards.name: Shatter
rareCards.description: Weaken the enemy for 3 turns: their attacks land for 1.75x less damage. Does not stack - reapplying keeps whichever effect is stronger and resets the 3 turns.

rareCards.name: Stun Strike
rareCards.description: Stun the enemy so they lose their next turn. Never stacks - a second Stun while one is active does nothing. Bosses often resist it.

rareCards.name: Venomous Lance
rareCards.description: Deal 12 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Poison 3: 2 damage a turn for 6 turns.

rareCards.name: Heal
rareCards.description: Restore yourself to 35% of maximum HP. If you are already above that, heal 14% instead.

rareCards.name: Dodge Reversal
rareCards.description: Counter: reverses the enemy's next attack or ailment back at them, doubled, +6, though a quarter of the blow still reaches you. Fizzles if they do neither.

rareCards.name: Iron Skin
rareCards.description: Gain 24 armor. 50% chance to Weaken the enemy for 3 turns, making their attacks land for 1.5x less damage.

rareCards.name: Bastion
rareCards.description: Gain 14 armor. It does not fade at the end of your turn: it lasts 3 turns or until an attack breaks it.

rareCards.name: Finishing Blow
rareCards.description: Deal 30 damage.

rareCards.name: Bloodlust
rareCards.description: Deal 13 damage, then gain x4 damage for 2 turns. Multiplies every attack you play, including riposte and counter damage. Stacks in duration, not power - a second cast adds turns and keeps the stronger multiplier. When the fury fades you are Weakened for a turn.

rareCards.name: Cyclone
rareCards.description: Deal 25 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Rend 3: 3 damage the next 3 times it attacks.

rareCards.name: Virulent Plague
rareCards.description: Apply 14 Poison. Deals 7 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 6 turns, ignoring armor. Slow, but it outlasts almost any fight. Stacks: another Poison adds to the tick and extends the timer, up to 12 turns.

rareCards.name: Hellfire
rareCards.description: Apply 12 Burn. Deals 18 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 2 turns, ignoring armor. Hits hard and burns out fast. Stacks: another Burn adds to the tick and extends the timer, up to 4 turns.

rareCards.name: Sunder
rareCards.description: Weaken the enemy for 3 turns: their attacks land for 2x less damage. Does not stack - reapplying keeps whichever effect is stronger and resets the 3 turns.

rareCards.name: Great Heal
rareCards.description: Restore yourself to 50% of maximum HP. If you are already above that, heal 20% instead.

rareCards.name: Reckoning
rareCards.description: Strike twice for 30 damage each, 60 total, and nothing reduces either hit. Ignores armor, defense, resistance, and any stance or phase the enemy is hiding behind.

rareCards.name: Storm
rareCards.description: Apply 8 Rend. The next 3 times the enemy attacks it takes 8 damage, ignoring armor. A stalling, buffing or stunned enemy takes nothing from it, and anything that swings twice a turn takes it twice. Stacks: another Rend adds to the hit and adds charges, up to 6.

rareCards.name: Tornado
rareCards.description: Apply 13 Rend. The next 3 times the enemy attacks it takes 13 damage, ignoring armor. A stalling, buffing or stunned enemy takes nothing from it, and anything that swings twice a turn takes it twice. Stacks: another Rend adds to the hit and adds charges, up to 6.

rareCards.name: Reckless Charge
rareCards.description: Deal 12 damage. You lose all your armor.

rareCards.name: Berserk Stance
rareCards.description: Your attacks deal x1.5 damage next turn, and you take x1.5 damage until then.

rareCards.name: Turtle Up
rareCards.description: Gain 14 armor that persists for 3 turns (until broken). You are Weakened for 3 turns.

rareCards.name: Burning Blade
rareCards.description: Deal 14 damage and apply 4 Burn. You gain 2 Burn.

rareCards.name: Adrenaline
rareCards.description: Gain 3 energy now. You start next turn with 2 less.

rareCards.name: Shatterpoint
rareCards.description: Deal 20 damage. You may play only one more card this turn.

rareCards.name: Blood Pact
rareCards.description: Gain x2 damage for 3 turns. Your maximum HP drops 15% for the rest of the encounter.

rareCards.name: Unstable Ward
rareCards.description: Gain 15 armor and ward yourself for 5 turns against every ailment. You draw two fewer cards next turn.

rareCards.name: Blight Maul
rareCards.description: Deal 26 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Poison 3: 2 damage a turn for 6 turns.

rareCards.name: Emberlance
rareCards.description: Deal 26 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Burn 3: 4 damage a turn for 2 turns.

rareCards.name: Downburst
rareCards.description: Deal 26 damage. 10% chance on hit to also apply Rend 3: 3 damage the next 3 times it attacks.

rareCards.name: All In
rareCards.description: Deal twice your current armor in damage, then lose all of it. You are Weakened for 2 turns.

rareCards.name: Last Stand
rareCards.description: Gain armor equal to the health you are missing, plus 5, and it persists. You cannot heal for the rest of the encounter.

rareCards.name: Borrowed Time
rareCards.description: Take another turn straight after this one. Then you are stunned for a turn, and your max HP drops to 60% for the rest of the encounter.

rareCards.name: Pact of Ruin
rareCards.description: Deal 24 damage. For the rest of the encounter every attack you play also applies 3 Burn and 2 Rend, you cannot heal, and every card you play costs you 6 HP.

rareCards.name: Sacrifice
rareCards.description: Restore yourself to full health. This card leaves your deck for the rest of the fight.
